title: Worker restart between durable claim and result record
description: A worker claims an operation durably, performs the effect, and crashes before storing the result.
assumptions: The external effect and local result store are not one atomic transaction.

expected.handling: Use recovery state, downstream idempotency, or reconciliation; the durable claim alone cannot prove effect status.

failure_modes: Replaying because result record is missing
Permanently suppressing retry despite an effect that never happened
notes: This is a distributed consistency boundary.
